title: 复盘 Google 2020 年职场承诺：如何说明投诉处理
topic: 从 Google 员工邮件中学习如何回应工作场所关切，并说明后续处理。

source.title: Building on our workplace commitments
source.type: 发给 Google 员工的邮件
paragraphs: Over the past several years, we have been taking a harder line on inappropriate conduct, and have worked to provide better support to the people who report it. Protecting our workplace and culture means getting both of these things right, and in recent years we’ve worked hard to set and uphold higher standards for the whole company. Thank you for your clear feedback as we’ve advanced this work.

The changes we’ve made to build a more equitable and respectful workplace include overhauling the way we handle and investigate employee concerns, introducing new care programs for employees who report concerns, and making arbitration optional for Google employees.
If there are allegations against any executives, a specialist team will be assigned and the results of any case will be reported to the Board’s Audit Committee.
translations: 过去几年，我们对不当行为采取了更严肃的处理方式，也努力为举报问题的人提供更好的支持。保护职场环境和文化，需要把这两件事都做好。近年来，我们一直努力为全公司设立并维护更高的标准。感谢大家在推进这些工作的过程中提出明确的反馈。
为建设更公平、更尊重员工的工作环境，我们调整了员工关切的处理和调查方式，为提出关切的员工增加了支持项目，并让 Google 员工可以自主选择是否仲裁。
如果指控涉及高管，将由专门团队负责调查，调查结果会报告给董事会审计委员会。
fullTextParagraphs: Editor’s Note: The following email was sent to the company today from Eileen Naughton, VP of People Operations.

Over the past several years, we have been taking a harder line on inappropriate conduct, and have worked to provide better support to the people who report it. Protecting our workplace and culture means getting both of these things right, and in recent years we’ve worked hard to set and uphold higher standards for the whole company. Thank you for your clear feedback as we’ve advanced this work.

The changes we’ve made to build a more equitable and respectful workplace include overhauling the way we handle and investigate employee concerns, introducing new care programs for employees who report concerns, and making arbitration optional for Google employees.

In late 2018, Alphabet’s Board responded to employee concerns by overseeing a comprehensive review of policies and practices related to sexual harassment, sexual misconduct, and retaliation. An independent committee of the Board also reviewed claims raised by shareholders in early 2019 about past workplace misconduct issues. Today we’re committing to five guiding principles and a list of detailed changes to our workplace policies and practices agreed to by the committee. These principles and improvements incorporate input from both employees and shareholders.
Below are some of the key changes we’re making.

We’re setting up a new DEI Advisory Council to advise on and oversee these efforts, with experts Judge Nancy Gertner (retired), Grace Speights, and Fred Alvarez joining Sundar, Chief Diversity Officer Melonie Parker, SVP of Global Affairs Kent Walker, and SVP of Core Jen Fitzpatrick. They will report to the Leadership Development and Compensation Committee of the Board (LDCC) on a quarterly basis on the company’s progress against these commitments.

We’re building on our current practice of prohibiting severance for anyone terminated for any form of misconduct, and expanding the prohibition to anyone who is the subject of a pending investigation for sexual misconduct or retaliation. Managers will also receive guidance instructing them on how misconduct should impact an employee's performance evaluation, compensation decisions, and promotion outcomes.
If there are allegations against any executives, a specialist team will be assigned and the results of any case will be reported to the Board’s Audit Committee.

We’ll ensure that $310 million in funding goes toward diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives and programs focused on increasing access to computer science education and careers; continuing to build a more representative workforce; fostering a respectful, equitable and inclusive workplace culture; and helping businesses from underrepresented groups to succeed in the digital economy and tech industry.

Other Bets are required to adhere to our new principles too. Changes they are making now include making arbitration optional for all employees, temporary staff, vendors, and independent contractors for individual harassment, discrimination, and retaliation disputes with Alphabet; as well as following the new Alphabet model for executive investigations. Every Alphabet company (including Google and all Other Bets) will be required to undertake an annual review of their own individual policies and practices to ensure they are consistent with Alphabet’s guiding principles in this area.

Together, Sundar, the DEI Advisory Council, and the Board will uphold Alphabet’s unwavering commitment to prohibit and respond effectively to complaints of sexual harassment, discrimination, and retaliation and promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Recent years have involved a lot of introspection and work to make sure we’re providing a safe and inclusive workplace for every employee. That doesn’t stop here and you’ll receive reports on our progress as we move forward. I’m grateful to everyone, especially our employees and shareholders, for providing us with feedback, and for making sure that the way we tackle these vital issues is better today than it was in the past.
verifiedFacts: 这封邮件由 Google People Operations 副总裁 Eileen Naughton 于 2020 年 9 月 25 日发给员工。
邮件称员工反馈推动了员工关切处理、员工支持项目和仲裁选项的调整。
涉及高管的指控由专门团队调查，结果报告给董事会审计委员会。
Google 来源发表于 2020-09-25；所述安排是该历史公告中的承诺，不应呈现为现行政策。
source.context: Google 于 2020 年 9 月发布的职场承诺；历史公告，不代表现行政策

notes.explain: set 强调制定标准，uphold 强调持续遵守和维护。
notes.example: We need to set and uphold higher standards for handling customer information.

notes.explain: handle and investigate 连用，既说明接收处理，也说明会查明情况。
notes.example: The People team will handle and investigate employee concerns.

notes.phrase: the company’s progress against these commitments
notes.meaning: 汇报各项承诺的落实进展
notes.explain: progress against 用于对照既定目标或承诺汇报实际进展。
notes.example: We’ll report progress against these commitments each quarter.

scenario.title: 虚构练习：解释投诉流程
english: Fictional exercise: an employee asks how a workplace concern will be reviewed.
The fictional company has updated its reporting process and assigned a specialist team for senior-level allegations.
Explain what changed, who handles the review, and how progress will be shared.
chinese: 虚构练习：一名员工询问工作场所关切会如何调查。
虚构公司已调整报告流程，并为涉及高管的指控安排专门团队。
说明流程变化、负责调查的团队和进展更新方式。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请复盘 Google 在 2020 年 9 月发布的职场承诺，用三句话说明：员工反馈推动了哪些变化；涉及高管的指控由谁处理；案件结果报告给谁。不要把历史公告表述成现行政策。
firstAttempt.sample: In a September 2020 workplace update, Google said employee feedback had led it to overhaul how concerns were handled and investigated and add support for people who reported them. It said allegations against executives would be assigned to a specialist team. The results of those cases would be reported to the Board’s Audit Committee.
firstAttempt.rationale: 明确这是 Google 2020 年的历史公告；依次交代反馈带来的变化、专门调查团队和结果汇报对象，不推断当前制度。

words.example: She raised a concern about how the schedule was assigned.
words.translation: 她提出了对排班分配方式的关切。

words.example: A separate team will investigate the allegation.
words.translation: 另一个团队会调查这项指控。

words.example: The policy protects employees from retaliation for raising concerns.
words.translation: 这项政策保护提出关切的员工免遭打击报复。

structure.original: Protecting our workplace and culture means getting both of these things right, and in recent years we’ve worked hard to set and uphold higher standards for the whole company.
analysis: means 后面用动名词短语说明“保护工作环境”需要做到什么。
both of these things 指前一句的两项工作：处理不当行为、支持提出问题的人。
set and uphold 把制定标准和持续执行放在一起表达。
structure.transfer: Protecting customer trust means responding to issues quickly and setting clear expectations across the team.

rewrite.bad: We have a policy for complaints.
rewrite.good: We’ve updated how we handle and investigate employee concerns.
rewrite.translation: 我们调整了员工关切的处理和调查方式。
rewrite.pattern: We’ve updated how we + 动词 1 and 动词 2 + 事项。

choice.question: 同事询问涉及管理层的投诉由谁调查，哪句说明了负责方和汇报去向？
options: The manager will decide whether the complaint is important.
A specialist team will investigate the allegation and report the results to the Board’s Audit Committee.
We have updated the policy, so there is no need to follow up.
choice.why: 第二句明确调查团队和结果汇报对象，没有提前判断投诉结论。

output.prompt: 虚构练习：一名员工提出排班分配可能存在不公平。请写三句话回复：说明谁负责核实、如何保护提出问题的人，以及何时提供下一次进展。不要把练习情境说成 Google 的现行流程。
output.sample: The People team will review how the schedule was assigned and speak with the people involved. We’ll handle the concern confidentially and make sure no one faces retaliation for raising it. I’ll share the next update by Friday, even if the review is still ongoing.
check: 表达处理关切的基本方式
